title: Non-Hermitian quantum phase transitions in the XY model induced by staggered imaginary Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction
summary: We investigate non-Hermitian quantum phase transitions driven by staggered imaginary Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya (DM) interactions in a transverse-field $XY$ chain. By virtue of a staggered nonunitary transformation, we exactly diagonalize the Hamiltonian. For $D 1$ regime falls into the $\mathcal{RT}$-symmetry-broken phase containing two distinct $z$-ferromagnetic phases. We examine common quantum-information probes and show that conventional measures, such as entanglement entropy, quantum discord, and quantum coherence, fail to capture the $\mathcal{RT}$ symmetry-breaking transition.
